resolution.details: Sasuke's Sharingan and speed challenge Neji's Byakugan. Sasuke uses shuriken, substitution, Katon Gokakyu, then Chidori against Neji's Kaiten. Chidori breaches outer chakra shield but is deflected, leaves superficial shoulder injury. Neji counters immediately with gentle-fist strikes to Sasuke's right arm and upper body. Genma stops after Sasuke is unable to rise without support and cannot continue reliably. Sasuke conscious, ambulatory after, right arm temporarily impaired. Neji exhausted, sore knee and shoulder wound. No permanent effects decided.
resolution.next: Final: Гаара — Нэдзи Хьюга; break announced at 11:31, ~20 minutes until next fight.

world: Gaara keeps looking at Shiki even while preparing for Neji; Temari observes discomfort and warns Gaara to focus. Kabuto appears out of medical work clothes on service stairs, glances at judges' box and main exit, then heads to restricted stadium passage; this is publicly observable, but motives remain unknown. Lee asks Shiki his view: «Для тебя бой — это прежде всего борьба с телом противника?» Shiki is at participant stands, has not answered. No voluntary new Shiki action. Shiki already surrendered to Gaara and tournament run ended, but remains present.
